case.title: Design- No technicians yet and Nothing here yet in both views
case.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Location {Location-B} has work orders but no technicians.
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST Location No Techs.
  • Location {Location-C} has no technicians and no work orders.
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST Location Empty.
  • You can change location to {Location-B} and {Location-C}.
  • User {User-B} can open Work Orders at {Location-B}, and their role does not have the permission "Settings → App".
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST C682436 Viewer, with a custom role that has only Work orders View.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. Change location to {Location-B}.
  2. Open "Work Orders" > "All" and click "Tech View".
  3. Click "Board View".
  4. Click "Add Technician".
  5. Change location to {Location-C}.
  6. Open "Work Orders" > "All" and click "Board View".
  7. Click "Tech View".
  8. Sign out and sign in as {User-B}.
  9. Change location to {Location-B}.
  10. Open "Work Orders" > "All" and click "Board View".
  11. Sign in as yourself again, change location to {Location-B}, open "Work Orders", click the "Estimates" tab and click "Board View". (The Estimates tab is empty when all of {Location-B}'s work orders are Approved; if it is not, use a tab that has no work orders.)
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the top bar shows {Location-B}.
  • Step 2: Tech View shows only the "Unassigned" group. Below it are a person icon, "No technicians yet", the text "Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned." and an "Add Technician" button.
  • Step 3: Board View shows only the "Unassigned" column, followed by the same icon, "No technicians yet", the same text and the "Add Technician" button.
  • Step 4: the Staff page in Settings opens (the page where staff are added).
  • Step 5: the top bar shows {Location-C}.
  • Step 6: Board View reads "Nothing here yet", then "Add technicians and create your first work order to track work by tech.", with a "Create Work Order" button and an "Add Technician" button.
  • Step 7: Tech View shows the same: "Nothing here yet", the same text, "Create Work Order" and "Add Technician".
  • Step 8: you are signed in as {User-B}.
  • Step 9: the top bar shows {Location-B}.
  • Step 10: Board View shows the "Unassigned" column and "No technicians yet" with its text, and there is no "Add Technician" button.
  • Step 11: the open tab has no work orders, so Board View reads "Nothing here yet", then "Add technicians and create your first work order to track work by tech.", with a "Create Work Order" button and an "Add Technician" button.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 81 (27 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043 · story SV-10044 · fast-follow ticket SV-11555 (Chris Ward on SV-11555, 27 Oct 2026: both states are judged on the open tab)

  • S1-N1d: “When the location has no technicians and the open tab has work orders, Tech View and Board View show only Unassigned, followed by the design’s state: the user-round icon, “No technicians yet”, then “Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned.”, with an Add Technician button. When the location has no technicians and the open tab has no work orders, the state reads “Nothing here yet”, then “Add technicians and create your first work order to track work by tech.”, with the Create Work Order button of S1-N1c and the Add Technician button. Both states are judged on the open tab, as S1-N1c and List view are: a location with work orders on other tabs still reads “Nothing here yet” on an empty tab. Add Technician opens Settings → Staff, the page where staff are added, and shows only to users with 'Settings → App', the permission that opens that page. When the Technician Toggle feature ships, its S3-R10 replaces this state's text and makes the button read "Set Up Technicians" and open Roles & Permissions ( Technician Toggle PRD ).”

Last checked against build v26.43.2-f8698cb (QA branch sv11555) on 10/28/2026.

References from Design

Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html and its flows, driven 14 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026: where the design draws these states; the expected results come from the PRD.

  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, first-run titles: “const frTitle = noWo && noTech ? "Nothing here yet" : noWo ? "No work orders yet" : "No technicians yet";”
  • Design — seen when driven (FLOWS-2026-10-14.md, W5): “no-technicians → "No technicians yet" + "Add technicians to assign work orders. Until then, every work order stays in Unassigned." + Add Technician”
